name: shadcnui-hono-jsx-workspace
description: Generator, tests and examples of shadcnui-hono-jsx (the CLI package is in cli/).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.strict.json
scripts.test:visual: cd tests/visual && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run test
scripts.test:visual:styles: cd tests/visual && bun install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../.. && bun tests/visual/styles.ts
scripts.examples:test: bun run --filter example-hono test && bun run --filter example-honox smoke
scripts.verify: bun run dev:install && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run generate --check
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run examples:build && bun run examples:typecheck && bun run examples:test && bun run test:install && bun run test:visual
